description: Search the Speedrun.com database for games by name. Returns matching games with their ID (needed for get_categories and get_leaderboard), abbreviation, release year, and weblink. Example: search_games({ query: "super mario 64", max: 5 })

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

max.description: Maximum number of games to return (default 10)

query.description: Game name or keyword to search for, e.g. "super mario 64", "celeste"

name: search_games
